title: MSFS Marketplace UPDATE! Dash 8‑200, Cutlass & T34B arrive on PC! ✈️🔥
description:
This week brings another exciting Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update! This week delivers some truly must‑have aircraft for PC simmers, including the highly anticipated Dash 8‑200 and a pair of standout military and trainer additions.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Virtualcol FS Software: DASH 8‑200 (Classic regional turboprop—great for short‑haul ops!)
🛫 Virtavia: F7U‑3M Cutlass (Unique Cold War naval jet—perfect for vintage jet fans!)
🛫 Carenado: T34B (A beautifully modeled trainer with great flight dynamics!)
